name: Nanjing Chemical Fibre Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in Nanjing, China, in 1964, Nanjing Chemical Fibre Co.,Ltd specializes in the production and sale of viscose fibers. These textile fibers, marketed under the Jinling brand, include both viscose filament and viscose staple varieties. In addition to its primary fiber business, the company diversifies its operations into water provision and pulp manufacturing. Nanjing Chemical Fibre's products are supplied across China and are also exported internationally to numerous regions, including South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Europe, and the United States.
